verdict.rationale: The IRS is a government service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server. The only machine channels shown are the credential-gated MeF XML/SOAP and IRIS A2A rails, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI all returned 404. These are not MCP servers and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
